status: Source-grounded construction gates and conditional count-model range; not a full runtime crossover bound

tiers.source_exact: Numbers and formulas explicitly stated in pinned source
tiers.derived_source_recipe: Algebraic consequences of the source's specified conservative implementation/guard prescriptions
tiers.conditional_count_model: Additional generous compiler-record-count envelope; not a source-certified physical Turing-time constant
tiers.unresolved_runtime: Needs primitive cost constants, final expanded program counts, setup/cutoff and a specified baseline implementation

source_exact.complex_moment_derivation: P/W < N^(1-uniform); relaxed saving b=uniform-1/1400000000, so normalized child moment < N^(-1/1400000000)=2^-45868
source_exact.bit_prime_lower_rule: odd q > 2^26 * N_BIT^5, also avoiding every fixed denominator and rank witness

mapping.input: n bits in each operand; b_in=ceil(log2 n); p=6*b_in
mapping.dimension: d=floor(b_in^epsilon), hence d<=p^epsilon with c=1 in the guard prescription
mapping.supplier_rank: N counts selected coordinate axes. It is not an input bit length or a scalar numeric precision.
mapping.first_compiled_call_gate: A width e=N*f+r call needs e>=N for f>=1; e<=d gives b_in>=N^(1/epsilon).
mapping.stopped_positive_child_gate: The source's sufficient stopped-tree gate is d^stop>=2N. This maps to b_in>=2^((H+1)/(epsilon*stop)).

derived_source_recipe.C0_formula: Z=W+O; G includes the complete expanded scalar and normalizer envelope; E=64*(Z+N+P+G+1)^3; B=P+E; C0=32*N*B^2
derived_source_recipe.precision_recipe: L=bit_length(4*C0); t=max(4,ceil(L/(1-epsilon))); p0=2^t. For p>=p0, guard C0*d<=p/4 and components have width<=2p.
derived_source_recipe.precision_recipe_height_lower: t-log2(6), with t at least the recorded exact integer
derived_source_recipe.interpretation: This is a lower bound on the size of this conservative sufficient cutoff recipe. It is NOT a necessary runtime-crossover bound or a lower bound for every alternative implementation.
derived_source_recipe.stopped_gate_interpretation: A sufficient implementation eligibility condition, not a proof that this is the minimum valid cutoff.

bit_stock.model_high_digit_gate: When one full fresh cover is exposed, w=ceil(e^(1/250)), e^(1/250)>=2 and k<e/2 require e^(249/250)>N_BIT^2 from its explicit high-matrix reservation alone.
bit_stock.qualification: This isolates one reservation term; all lower-type, role and ancestor reserves still have to be added.

conditional_count_model.model_owner: Independent leaderboard_source compiler audit; consult its proof before treating this as an established count bound
conditional_count_model.K_reason: A=10^10 bounds the raw p16 budget, fields, calls and rank. A deliberately generous separated-product record model is K=A^(8*(1024+1))=10^82000 < 2^(2^20), including dense binary normalizers; this is not a physical runtime model.
conditional_count_model.expanded_count_upper: D_N=K^(32*4^N), bounding W,P,raw U and native record/normalizer R in the stated count model
conditional_count_model.precision_gate_range: For this count model only, substitute t_lower<=t<=t_upper into n_precision=2^(ceil(2^t/6)). It bounds the conservative precision recipe, not all eligibility conditions or runtime.
conditional_count_model.count_to_precision_check: D_N>=N, G<=2*K*D_N and Z<=2*D_N imply S=Z+N+P+G+1<=3*K*D_N, E<2^11*K^3*D_N^3, B<2^12*K^3*D_N^3; the stated 2^30 C0 bound is generous.

runtime_conclusion.source_grounded_cost_shape: T_PR(n)<=n*sum_j A_j*(log2 n)^(1-g_j)*(1+log2(log2 n))^r_j+T_setup(n), with the nine exact power savings g_j in CLAIM.json. The template-dependent A_j, retained polylog powers r_j and common validity cutoff are not numerically emitted.
runtime_conclusion.conditional_sufficient_crossover: If all nine complete rows including polylogs are each established to be <=A*n*(log2 n)^(1-s) on n>=n_gate, a specified baseline is >=B*n*log2 n, and setup<=B*n*log2 n/2, then n>=max(n_gate,2^((18*A/B)^(1/s))) suffices. One may choose s=kappa only after proving a numeric polylog-absorption gate from the strict g_j-kappa gaps. Actual established A,B and the setup bound are still required.
missing: Exact or source-certified full expanded W,P,U,R and all rational matrix/denominator heights
Numeric native movement, generic fallback, coefficient arithmetic and fixed-tape primitive time constants
A complete effective joint cutoff covering precision, role/cover stock, phase grouping, prime setup and analytic recovery
A concrete comparator machine/implementation and its actual lower time envelope; a Big-O upper bound is insufficient
runtime_conclusion.what_the_new_bounds_change: They rule out interpreting the tiny equal-constant 1.01x proxy as a full-construction estimate. The explicit guarded implementation has astronomically larger eligibility scales, even before the full counts are substituted.

hvh_baseline.primary_locations: Section 5 pp36-37, final proof pp41-42, introductory constants statement p2
hvh_baseline.proved_global_constant_prescription: C=max(B,5000*A), where B=max_{2<=n<n0} M(n)/(n log n); A bounds the fixed additive term in the normalized recurrence and is not numerically provided
hvh_baseline.optimization_outline: Section5.4 outlines reducing K from1728 to8+epsilon, permitting d=9; it does not fully cost this implementation or establish a canonical practical baseline constant.
hvh_baseline.qualification: These are algorithm-family recursion cutoffs, not practical break-even sizes against other multiplication implementations.

impact_certificate.scope: PR4470 at the pinned source. Source formulas and exact arithmetic have been checked; no new complete multiplication proof or implementation is claimed.
impact_certificate.actual_crossover_status: Not numerically established for either specified Harvey-van der Hoeven machine family or a practical GMP/computer baseline

checklist.checked: Pinned CLAIM.json and RESULT.json agree on 60403/20000000, complete local target/paid invoice, and nine outer power savings.
checklist.remaining: Acceptance remains under the named all-size interfaces; a finite invoice is not a complete machine-time proof.

checklist.checked: N is selected-coordinate rank; p=6*ceil(log2 n), d=floor(ceil(log2 n)^epsilon), and the source stopped-child gate d^stop>=2N have been algebraically connected.
checklist.remaining: This maps a sufficient gate, not every condition in the full multiplication algorithm or the least possible gate.

checklist.checked: C0=32*N*(P+64*(Z+N+P+G+1)^3)^2 and the source p0 recipe give the exact minimum-recipe height recorded here.
checklist.remaining: Actual full W,P,U,R,G are not emitted; the coefficient guard budget C0 is not the total runtime multiplier.

checklist.checked: A separate generous record-count envelope gives compressed upper bounds for W,P,U,R and hence the precision recipe, under its stated counting assumptions.
checklist.remaining: The source compiler has not emitted its complete numerical word, matrix/denominator heights or a certified complete physical execution tariff.

checklist.checked: The maintainer review checks changed native operators, phases, ownership and source-identical foundations within its explicit scope.
checklist.remaining: The all-column native, whole-job, owned-erasure and uniform compiler contracts remain premises. A finite threshold proof must specify which conditional version is being bounded rather than treat them as discharged.

checklist.checked: The notes charge actual scalar work, normalizers, fixed matrix movement, cover routing and fallback through asymptotic native interfaces.
checklist.remaining: A numeric time bound needs coefficients for bit arithmetic, ordered movement, fixed-tape passes, cover normalizers and generic bad-class fallback in one specified machine cost model.

checklist.checked: There are explicit precision, stopped-child, prime-lower and row-reserve formulas. The current epsilon and layout slacks are exactly positive.
checklist.remaining: A common numeric cutoff must also enforce combined role/cover stock, grouping, descriptor preparation, polylog absorption, prime/denominator exclusions and analytic recovery. The current package does not emit that joint value.

checklist.checked: The exact outer ledger remains strict and identifies the limiting power row and its slack.
checklist.remaining: Analytic decomposition, fine-prime avoidance, precision/tape interfaces and exact recovery remain inherited. Their implementation constants and effective domains must be part of the same conditional cutoff certificate.

checklist.checked: The authors' main family fixes d=1729 and n0=2^(1729^12), with C=max(B,5000*A).
checklist.remaining: Select the actual base-case machine and arithmetic conventions and compute A and B; also establish a lower time envelope for that machine if proving that PR4470 runs faster, rather than comparing two upper bounds.

checklist.checked: No materialized PR4470 uniform word or end-to-end multiplication implementation is claimed in the source.
checklist.remaining: Choose the practical software/version, CPU, threads and memory model; benchmark its complete multiplication. PR4470 must be implemented or assigned an independently justified physical cost law before a comparison can be measured. Extrapolated GMP timings are scenarios, not proofs at astronomical input sizes.

checklist.checked: The history audit separately retains invalid, local-only, wrong-model and provisional proposals instead of treating all PRs as accepted algorithms.
checklist.remaining: For each genuine global construction, repeat the exact-source count/guard/primitive/baseline audit. A compiler-only improvement may change constants while leaving kappa fixed; a greater kappa may have larger finite constants. Rejected or incomplete claims cannot acquire a proved crossover merely by being listed.

impact_certificate.what_would_complete_a_finite_comparison: Supply a concrete conditional candidate machine or executable with a verified complete upper time envelope on n>=n_gate, a specified comparator with a valid lower time envelope there, and solve their inequality including setup/base cases. Source-derived guard recipes and calibrated timing models are useful intermediate evidence but do not by themselves fulfill those three obligations.
